en: Fixed model switches through the Agent SDK's `setModel()`, and apps built on it, being refused when the API took more than 5 seconds to confirm the model; Claude Code now waits up to 15 seconds
zh: 修复了通过 Agent SDK 的 `setModel()` 以及基于它构建的应用进行模型切换时，在 API 确认模型耗时超过 5 秒的情况下被拒绝的问题；Claude Code 现在最多等待 15 秒
